The double tribal and “class” character can be seen in the way a tribal chief sometimes received his tribe’s share and then kept it for himself and his closest relatives. The jizya could be paid in cash or in kind, for example in clothing. The original upper limit for a cash payment was one dinar, or thirteen dirhams, per person each year. Later, this amount became the minimum, and two dinars or twenty-four dirhams could be taken, and sometimes four dinars from a wealthy person.↩︎

Zakat is due from every sane adult, provided the wealth is fully owned and the owner is able to dispose of it. The types of wealth subject to zakat are gold, silver, camels, cattle, sheep and goats, wheat, barley, dates, and raisins. The minimum amount on which zakat becomes due varies by type of wealth. 1. Gold: for every twenty dinars of gold, half a dinar is due; below that amount there is no zakat. 2. Silver: there is no zakat below two hundred dirhams; after two hundred, nothing further is due until the amount reaches forty more dirhams, at which point one dirham is due. 3. Camels: there is no zakat below five camels; at five, one sheep is due, and so on. 4. Cattle: for every thirty cattle, one yearling calf is due; below that there is no zakat. For forty cattle, one mature cow is due, with further details beyond this. 5. Sheep: for every forty sheep, one sheep is due; below that there is no zakat, with further details beyond this. Zakat on these kinds of livestock is due only under certain conditions: the minimum threshold must be reached, the animals must not be working animals, and a full year must have passed. 6. Crops—wheat, barley, dates, and raisins: zakat becomes due at roughly 910 kilograms; below that there is no zakat, provided the underlying crops are owned by the person concerned. As for the rate, if the crop is irrigated artificially, zakat is half of one tenth. If it is watered naturally by a river, spring, rain, or grows without artificial irrigation, the full tenth is due. الكتاب: النزعات المادية في الفلسفة العربية - الإسلامية (المجلد الأول)

إن أحداً من المهتمين بالشأن الثقافي لا يجهل الأهمية الفكرية التاريخية لصدور كتاب العلامة الشهيد حسين مروة «النزعات المادية في الفلسفة العربية - الإسلامية»، ولا يجهل الفراغ الذي سده الكتاب، الذي أراده كاتبه موسوعياً، في المكتبة العربية، وبشكل خاص المكتبة الديمقراطية والتقدمية، والمكتبات الفردية للمثقفين بشكل عام وللتقدميين منهم خاصة، هذا عدا طلاب الجامعات وكافة المهتمين بالشأن الثقافي العام.
